question: How many powers are traditionally remembered in this enumerated group including Kālī, Gaurī, and Śivā?
premises: Kālī, Gaurī, and Śivā are named among the powers.
The enumeration concludes with a total count.
inference: Therefore this group is traditionally remembered as consisting of eight powers.
uncertainties: Only three names are explicitly listed in this verse; the remaining names of the eight powers are not given here.
plain_english: Kālī, Gaurī, and Śivā, and so on—thus eight powers are remembered.
